items.title: Student numbers before and after PAL introduction

source.label: IRCC national and Alberta series

metricDefinitions.label: IRCC national and Alberta series
metricDefinitions.definition: National counts exclude permit extensions; Alberta DLI permit-effective counts include extensions and have different scope.

caveats: No comparable public annual Alberta new-arrivals series was located.
National initial-holder and Alberta DLI counts must not be divided to estimate Alberta’s share of arrivals.
PAL did not exist before January 22, 2024; missing allocations are not zero.
2020 was affected by pandemic travel restrictions.

items.title: Policy events and graduate allocation interpretation

source.label: Official policy and institutional records

metricDefinitions.label: Official policy and institutional records
metricDefinitions.definition: The timeline distinguishes policy effective dates, announcements and institutional reports.

caveats: Verified policy mechanisms do not establish quantified causal effects on admissions.
Master’s and doctoral PAL coverage changed in 2024, 2025 and 2026.
The financial-threshold historical-date discrepancy is retained in the detailed matrix.

rows.event: Financial threshold increased; announced December 7 2023
rows.affected_cohort: New study permit applicants
rows.measured_number: CAD 20635 living expenses plus first-year tuition and travel
rows.evidence_strength: Verified policy; demand effect not quantified
rows.limitations: Pre-PAL accompanying reform; not proof of lower application demand

rows.event: PAL requirement and two-year cap introduced
rows.affected_cohort: Most new college and undergraduate applicants; masters/doctoral and K-12 exempt
rows.measured_number: Approximately 360000 initial planned new permits
rows.limitations: Initial headline was revised; no six-year PAL series exists; applications already received exempt

rows.event: Longer PGWP available for eligible shorter masters degrees
rows.affected_cohort: Masters graduates from programs shorter than two years
rows.measured_number: 3-year PGWP
rows.limitations: Subject to all other eligibility criteria; a positive incentive alongside restrictions

rows.event: Alberta issues first PALs after February29 institutional allocations
rows.affected_cohort: Alberta publicly funded DLIs initially prioritized
rows.measured_number: First letters March1; allocations reflect2023permits with modest growth where possible
rows.limitations: Not evidence of exact applications delayed; initially publicly funded cohort represented over95% of provincial international enrolment per report

rows.event: Initial spouse open-work-permit eligibility restricted
rows.affected_cohort: Spouses/common-law partners of international students
rows.measured_number: Eligibility limited to graduate degrees; eligible pilots; selected professional degrees
rows.limitations: Distinct from additional16-month masters restriction effectiveJanuary21,2025; no measured causal share

rows.event: Final provincial allocations and top-ups published
rows.affected_cohort: 2024 capped cohorts
rows.measured_number: Alberta 40894 application spaces and 24537 expected permits
rows.limitations: Not actual permits or arrivals; initial Alberta population allocation 45824 was superseded

rows.event: PGWP eligibility removed for new public-private curriculum licensing college cohorts
rows.affected_cohort: Students beginning affected college programs
rows.measured_number: Implementation accelerated from September 1 to May 15
rows.evidence_strength: Verified policy; university impact cannot be generalized
rows.limitations: Contemporaneous March22 notice uses on-or-after May15; current eligibility page uses after May15; edge-date discrepancy retained

rows.event: 2025 target reduction and wider reforms announced
rows.affected_cohort: Study permit applicants; prospective graduate and family cohorts
rows.measured_number: 437000 permits for 2025
rows.limitations: Announcement date; later implementation dates govern; 437000 includes more than PAL-required new arrivals

rows.event: PGWP language and eligible-field rules take effect
rows.affected_cohort: Most PGWP applicants; new study applicants to college or shorter non-degree university programs
rows.measured_number: CLB7 university graduates; CLB5 college graduates; eligible fields for specified non-degree cohorts
rows.evidence_strength: Verified policy; effect on admissions unmeasured
rows.limitations: Bachelor/master/doctoral degrees exempt from field restriction; do not claim all university programs lose PGWP

rows.event: DLI-change permit rule and 24-hour off-campus work limit effective
rows.affected_cohort: Students changing schools; eligible off-campus workers; DLIs
rows.measured_number: 24 hours/week during study periods
rows.limitations: November15 news release is publication date; rule is not a measured PAL shortfall cause

rows.event: SDS and Nigeria Student Express closed
rows.affected_cohort: Applicants formerly eligible for expedited streams
rows.measured_number: 14 SDS countries plus Nigeria scheme
rows.evidence_strength: Verified policy; net demand effect unmeasured
rows.limitations: Earlier eligible applications grandfathered; regular study permit route remains

rows.event: Family open-work-permit eligibility narrowed
rows.affected_cohort: Spouses of masters students in shorter programs especially
rows.measured_number: Masters program minimum 16 months; doctoral and specified professional programs eligible
rows.limitations: Not a ban on all student spouses; preserve eligible exceptions

rows.event: 2025 PAL scope and cap legally take effect
rows.affected_cohort: Masters/doctoral and other in-scope applications; listed exemptions retained
rows.measured_number: 550162 maximum in-scope applications January22–December31,2025
rows.limitations: January24notice is explanatory publication; Jan1–21transition governed by preceding cap instructions

rows.event: Calgary reports prior-year application decline and unused PALs
rows.affected_cohort: University of Calgary international applicants in 2024
rows.measured_number: Approximately 40% application decline; exact PAL use undisclosed
rows.limitations: No numerical institutional utilization rate; meeting reports 2024; anticipated2025graduate split not final allocation

rows.event: 2025 provincial allocations published; scope effective January22
rows.affected_cohort: Masters/doctoral; most in-Canada applicants; continuing same-DLI same-level renewals exempt
rows.measured_number: Alberta 47338 spaces including 5256 graduate; expected 32660 permits
rows.limitations: Other PAL-required cohort includes more than university undergraduates; graduate spaces combine masters and doctoral

rows.event: Toronto reports all 2024 allocation used
rows.affected_cohort: University of Toronto international applicants
rows.measured_number: 100% as qualitative all-used statement; counts not supplied here
rows.limitations: Meaning of used not defined at application/issuance stage; not proof every PAL led to arrival

rows.event: Living-funds threshold adjusted
rows.affected_cohort: Study permit applicants outside Quebec
rows.measured_number: CAD 22895 excluding tuition/travel
rows.evidence_strength: Verified contemporaneous IRCC QP note; contradictory dynamic page
rows.limitations: QP note gives Sept1; dynamic financial page later labels Jan1,2025. Use contemporaneous date and preserve discrepancy

rows.event: 2026 allocations announced
rows.affected_cohort: PAL-required cohorts; all-permit planning includes exempt cohorts
rows.measured_number: Alberta 32271 spaces; 21582 expected PAL-required permits; Canada 408000 total permits
rows.limitations: Expected issuance not actual2026 utilization; 155000 new arrivals and253000 extensions are national planning split

rows.event: Public-DLI masters and doctoral students PAL-exempt again
rows.affected_cohort: Degree-granting masters/doctoral programs at public institutions
rows.measured_number: No PAL required for eligible cohort
rows.limitations: Does not apply to every graduate certificate or private institution; lower PAL counts need not mean fewer graduate admissions

rows.event: OAG findings reproduced in committee briefing
rows.affected_cohort: Postsecondary application cohorts through September2025
rows.measured_number: Lower volumes and approval yield; 23/51 sampled financial refusals had unclear expected documents
rows.limitations: Briefing date; not original audit release date. Audit excludes K-12 and tracks application receipt cohorts

rows.event: Latest living-funds threshold applies
rows.affected_cohort: Applicants outside Quebec
rows.measured_number: CAD 23448 for one person excluding tuition/travel
rows.limitations: Dynamic page; no causal estimate; most collected2026student counts endJuly so predate this event

items.title: Fewer applications and lower approval yield

source.label: Auditor General study-permit cohorts

metricDefinitions.label: Auditor General study-permit cohorts
metricDefinitions.definition: Approval yield is approvals divided by applications received in the audit’s post-secondary application cohorts.

caveats: This is not university PAL utilization.
The audit excludes primary and secondary schools and follows application-received cohorts.
2025 remains partial and includes pending applications.
The audit did not establish why approval yields fell; a descriptive decomposition is not a causal attribution.

rows.period_scope: Partial: as of September 2025; about 26,000 pending new applications
